svg.title: Call360 pipeline framework
svg.desc: Step 1: every source runs the same four BigQuery steps (population, join and enrich, status buckets with a global member ID, final insert) behind an audit check that gives each run its own ID and blocks duplicate runs. Step 2: one factory DAG reads a list of 14 sources and generates a load job per source, which reads the BigQuery tables and loads Bigtable. A new source is one config entry, with no new pipeline code.
svg.text: STEP 1 · BIGQUERY: SAME FOUR STEPS FOR EVERY SOURCE
audit check before every write · one ID per run · duplicate runs blocked
STEP 2 · BIGTABLE: ONE FACTORY DAG FOR ALL 14 SOURCES
A new source = one config entry.
